gatoh.utils.random_coinflip

random_coinflip(return_type: str) → T[source]

Simulates a random coinflip, returning the result as either a boolean, an integer, a float, or a string.

The exact return type strings supported are:

  • “bool”

  • “int”

  • “float”

  • “string”

Parameters:

return_type (str) – The data type of the returned coinflip result.

Returns:

The outcome of the random coinflip.

Return type:

bool | int | float | str
